n: Cameo® Keypad - International Version, White Textured (C2NI-CB-W-T)
d: C2NI-CB-W-T Cameo® Keypad - International Version, White Textured

specs.label: Connections input
specs.value: (2) 3-pin 3.5 mm detachable terminal blocks; Comprises (2) dry contact closure sensing inputs

specs.label: NET
specs.value: 4-pin 3.5 mm detachable terminal block; Cresnet secondary port, connects to a Cresnet control network

specs.label: Keypad
specs.value: Plastic with metal mounting plate; Textured white, almond, or black finish

specs.label: Faceplate / Bezel
specs.value: Plastic faceplate included, color-matched to keypad; Architectural series faceplates ( C2NI/INETI-FP series ) available separately

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Mounts in a 1-Gang UK (BS 4662) electrical box, 1-Gang European (DIN 49073) electrical box, or 51 x 51 mm (2 x 2 in.) cutout
